reviews.x: For my first time buying wigs I was lost on how to store them. And then I came across these and thought well why not they are cheap. I was amazed at how strong they were. I use them for hanging my wigs all the time. And my wigs stay straight and detangled!!!! So for the price I'm very happy with what I got.

reviews.t: Not what I expected. Did not meet my expectations.
reviews.x: I did not like the fact that the round top that is suppose to snap into place, didn’t snap into place.  No matter what I would do I could not get it to stay in place. On either one. Two were included.  That’s why 3 stars.
Assembled easily, and the instructions are humorous (Engrish).  Because they're plastic, wigs can snag on the holders.  I placed wig caps on them, to keep that from happening.
A main piece was missing so I only received one complete wig hanger. The second hanger was not really functional.

reviews.t: Sturdy!! And only needs commen sense to put ...
reviews.x: Sturdy !! And only needs commen sense to put together!! Lovely !!

reviews.t: Awesome simple product.... Must have for long Wigs...
reviews.x: My wife (Cancer Survivor) (Asian) bought some long black wigs to have her hair back as it never came back the same again after treatment. I just bought these for her to hang the two new wigs on in the closet and man are these nice. They just snap together with no tools and so sturdy.... If you have the room and have any long wigs these things are the way to go. I highly, Highly recommend these and give them 10********** ..... God Bless, Richard W.

reviews.t: They would be easy to assemble if they didn't break and weren't missing parts
reviews.x: I ordered 2 sets of 2 of these from this seller. I only opened one set of 2 in time to return them when the cap piece of one broke. Now it's 5 days after the 30 day window and just opened the other set of two and the first one is missing on piece, but thought maybe it would work without it so tried to assemble without it and the same piece, the cap piece, broke instantly. UGH. I suggest you purchased a different brand.

I ordered these wig stands because I got tired of having the big styrofoam heads taking up shelf room in my closet.  This is a little disappointing.  They don't hold wigs all that securely and it's not great for brushing/styling.  3 stars, and I think I'll be going back to the big foam heads on the shelf.  They're okay, but if you have the closet room, stick with the foam.

2 pack. 1 arrived broken. Not a shocker considering how thin the plastic is. I returned them and am not interested in a replacement. The hanger part is nice and thick but many of the connecting pieces are paper thin. Shame because it is a pretty good design, but they cut corners in the manufacturing/design to save insignificant amounts of plastic..

I honestly really adored this purchase. It was easy to assemble (the top circle part was the hardest but I learned how to apply it easily), and it held my longer wigs perfectly! Definitely going to purchase more when I need more space.

I have two wigs and I really needed somewhere to put them besides in a box so they don’t get kinks in odd places. These are great! The top plastic circle pops off sometimes when I take the wig off, but other than that they’re perfect.

One of the wig stands arrived with an obvious manufacturing default and is unusable. While the other one seems fairly sturdy overall, even shipping this one out was a huge miss. Would not purchase from this supplier again.

The first time I received these, one of the anchors was detached, so I returned them. Received my replacement immediately, intact. This is a great product for drying my wigs. Light and snaps together relatively easily.

reviews.t: The best way to store my wigs.
reviews.x: I love the wig hangers because my wigs are able to hang freely. I am installing a curtain rod in my closet to hang my wigs. They are currently hanging very well beside my clothes. Received my second pair this week.

Easy to assemble, the top circle on one of them wasn't snug and popped off but it is on there okay ... for the price it's okay but not perfect.  wig stays on it just great though and will help dry them too!
With these wig hangers, you get the "bang for your buck!" They're easy to put together, save tons of space, and the value for money is amazing. I've bought 9 of these lol. Would DEFINITELY buy again.
Easy assembly, my wigs fit/hang nicely.  The plastic is a little thin if you're constantly taking wigs on and off. I'm not, so it should be fine.  Not for professional use.

reviews.t: One wig hanger was broken when I opened the package.
reviews.x: Perfect, though I ordered two wig hangers and one was broken with a slit across when I tried to put it together... I guess it’s still functional but a little less sturdy.
My gf and I live in a relatively small place and these things have been a life saver. I added a pole to our bedroom wall and now all her wigs  are on display.
They keep curving to the side when I hang them up and my wigs tend to slide but otherwise I love these. Easy to put together and a good price.

reviews.t: I DON'T KNOW YET BUT WILL FOLLOW UP
reviews.x: I am having trouble getting them together, but I will try again or have someone help me. If they work then they will be worth the money.
I expected it to be smaller but it’s a decent size for the price. Feels very sturdy and helps me save space in my small apartment !

reviews.t: Easy to put together & does the job!
reviews.x: These are awesome, sturdy and so easy to put together. I purchased them for my daughters dress up wigs to keep them tangle free!
I find these wig hangers to be the perfect thing to dry my wigs on. The cap drys completely at the same time as the hair.
Product came opened, with missing pieces. Not worth the time, effort, and risk to return during the current covid crisis.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the wig hangers easy to assemble and sturdy once put together.
Several reviewers report the round top/cap piece does not snap or stay in place securely and pops off.
Some reviewers received broken, missing, or defective parts, with thin plastic cited as a quality concern.
Reviewers praise the hangers for storing and hanging wigs, keeping them straight and detangled, and for drying wigs.
A few reviewers note wigs can snag on the plastic holders or that they don't hold wigs securely for styling.
